cases.prompt: Prepare a bounded engineering task for adding a tooling regression test. Describe its branch, base, allowed files and handoff. Do not edit tracked files.
An interrupted engineering task has local edits. Inspect how this repository resumes tasks and checks cleanup safety. Preserve every local edit and do not delete anything.
Assess engineering verification readiness using the repository diagnostics. Keep missing dependencies explicit and show the verification evidence procedure. Do not install tools.
A previous verification report refers to a different source SHA. Determine whether it can be used for this engineering handoff, and inspect the evidence validator without modifying sources.
Inspect the complete generated artifact boundary, including placement Tcl and filler RTL. Use the existing inventory interface and keep the worktree unchanged.
A generated package file is reported stale. Inspect the owning source and the correct read-only diagnostic workflow. Do not regenerate or hand-edit any file.
Assess whether the existing environment can perform an IHP real-library check. Record missing PDK/tool prerequisites. Do not start physical hardening or install anything.
Review the execution policy for a legacy command that disables Netgen LVS and the power-grid checker. Explain whether it is permitted by current repository rules. Do not execute it.
Prepare a dev-to-main release readiness assessment using current refs and verification requirements. Do not commit, merge, tag, push, publish or open a PR.
Explain in one paragraph why digital clocks have a frequency. This is an ordinary conceptual question; no repository work is requested.
